{"id":2032978590,"question_id":50,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781452215,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2032978590/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Pow(x, n)","memory":"8.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    double myPow(double x, int n) {\n        double power = 1;\n        long long exp = n;\n        \n        if(exp < 0)\n        {\n            x = 1.0 / x;\n            exp = -exp;\n        }\n\n        while(exp != 0)\n        {\n            if(exp & 1) power *= x;\n            x *= x;\n            exp >>= 1;\n        }\n        return power;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"powx-n","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2107}
